name: MMPY
title: MM regression estimator using Pen~a-Yohai candidates
description:
This function computes MM-regression estimator using Pen~a-Yohai
candidates for the initial S-estimator. This function is used
internally by ``lmrobdetMM``, and not meant to be used
directly.

arguments.description: a list of control parameters as returned by ``lmrobdet.control``

author: Victor Yohai, <victoryohai@gmail.com>, Matias Salibian-Barrera, <matias@stat.ubc.ca>
